reviewed_semantics: Publication mutation dispatch retains exact raw-byte hash and row presence, byte-bounded reads, missing-only insertion, strict UTF-8/casefold/wire projection and richer API identity/owner/lease validators; no cache or caller-supplied published boolean becomes authority.

Private scenario create/update compares initial/final publication facts, immutable deduplicated sources and transaction source incarnation/content nonce; deterministic publication/project/scenario/source/pool lock ordering remains. Real prepared unmutated survivor test refuses both stale and refreshed publication snapshots until terminal claim without changing parent durable rows.

Portable library default duration and explicit empty shape are normalized on private copies after portable validation; nondefault duration/iterations, workload shape, Results/SLA/runtime/group fields remain in recovery/content comparisons.

Queued-source canonical 0s clear remains actual-admission-only, requires unstarted/unended matching ID/project and same supported mode; ordinary/scenario and forged-ID zero still refuse. Positive iteration delay retains ordinary behavior. Final admission includes EndedAt/mode and lightweight cached required feature is honored only without a present DSL.

HAR writer close ownership is not inferred from ordinary early-nil or server close; SDK owner uses single physical close winner, retained result and dispatcher repeat refusal. Platform owner runs asynchronous native close and retains runtime/document/limiter/worker joins; caller deadlines do not confer completed-retirement authority.

Document neutral begin/finish, current-frame merge and bounded native Evaluate cancellation remain compatible with HAR teardown. Sensitive working namespace and exact retired-file identities remain distinct from archive-resource materialization leases.

Resource query rechecks canonical durable run/archive owner and pointer, manifest/artifact/inode/source fingerprint plus current presented credential authority before response; cursor binds query/authority/source/format/sort and expires. Explicit project mismatch and cross-project replacement refuse.

Raw disclosed transaction evidence reaches JSONL/Parquet resource projection before typed absent fields can appear as zeros. Summary-only retained populations do not claim capture coverage or raw observations; native zero and false remain representable.

CLI admits bounded exact query/scope before I/O, does not follow redirects, bounds response bytes and page count and rejects wrong canonical run/project. Resource-generated Swagger/catalog/TypeScript contract and M1 coherence remain stable from the immediately preceding independent review.
Public full scenario If-Match support and strict policy enabling remain explicitly unavailable; the private durable primitive is not advertised as a supported vertical.
